dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent closed-loop 'O' shaped annuli are visible on the mid-lateral flank. These exhibit sharp, irregular dark perimeters that transition abruptly into lighter grey centers. Three primary structures form a cluster posterior to the flipper, characterized by thin, high-contrast dark boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of independent solid blobs. Most high-intensity pixel clusters are localized within the interiors of the macro-annuli rather than forming distinct, asymmetrical solid blobs across the pelt.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-lateral surface form an obtuse triangle. A fourth smaller annulus is located posterior to this group, forming a non-linear chain-like relationship along the lateral midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent transverse linear indentation is visible on the posterior torso near the tail base. Deep, parallel dermal folds are present in the cervical region.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced radial arrangement of dark whiskers on the snout. Symmetrical dark pigmentation areas are present around the eyes.
